proof_body:
by
  intro f w _
  constructor
  · rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_neg_eq_self (fun v : ℝ => Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * (-w) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f v)]
    congr 1
    funext v
    congr 3
    ring
  · rw [← integral_conj]
    congr 1
    funext v
    rw [map_mul, ← Complex.exp_conj]
    congr 2
    simp only [map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
    push_cast
    ring
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ), MeasureTheory.Integrable f MeasureTheory.volume → (∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f (-v) = ∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * (-w) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f v) ∧ (∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (f v) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * (-w) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f v))
